items.title_zh: Google发布Gemini 4 Carbon，聚焦网络安全
items.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon AI model with cybersecurity focus
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，Google发布了名为Gemini 4 Carbon的AI模型，定位聚焦网络安全场景。现有公开信息主要确认了模型名称与方向，关于具体能力、可用范围、发布时间和合作伙伴等细节尚未披露。此举表明Google正继续把Gemini模型推向安全等垂直行业应用。
items.summary_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon AI model with cybersecurity focus Reuters
items.why_zh: 网络安全是AI企业落地的关键高价值场景，Google的新模型可能加剧该领域的平台竞争。
items.why_en: Cybersecurity is a high-value enterprise AI use case, and Google's new model could intensify platform competition in the space.

items.title_zh: Google一个月内发布第二款重要AI模型Gemini 4 Carbon
items.title_en: Google Launches Gemini 4 Carbon, Its Second Major AI Model in a Month
items.summary_zh: 据The Information报道，Google推出了Gemini 4 Carbon，这是其在一个月内发布的第二款重要AI模型。报道未在摘要中披露该模型的具体参数、能力评测或商业化安排。连续发布重要模型显示出Google正在加快Gemini产品线的迭代节奏。
items.summary_en: Google Launches Gemini 4 Carbon, Its Second Major AI Model in a Month The Information
items.why_zh: 一个月内两次发布重要模型，说明头部AI厂商的模型迭代与竞争正在明显提速。
items.why_en: Two major model launches in one month show that leading AI vendors are accelerating iteration and competition.

items.title_zh: Artificial Analysis发布Intelligence Index v5基准，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash开源模型编码能力登顶
items.title_en: Artificial Analysis releases Intelligence Index v5; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash tops open-source coding
items.summary_zh: Artificial Analysis发布Intelligence Index v5基准，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash开源模型编码能力登顶 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Artificial Analysis has released Intelligence Index v5, with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ranking first among open-source models in coding capability, according to Sina Finance. The result highlights the model's strong performance on code-related evaluations under the new benchmark.
items.why_zh: 新基准下的排名变化会影响外界对开源模型能力格局的判断，尤其是在编码这一关键场景。
items.why_en: Rankings under a new benchmark can reshape perceptions of open-source model capabilities, especially in coding.

items.title_zh: 苹果首款触控屏 MacBook Pro 正式发布：双层串联 OLED、低至 1.38 千克重量，22,999 元起
items.title_en: Apple unveils first touchscreen MacBook Pro with tandem OLED, starting at ¥22,999
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，苹果在今天的特别活动中正式推出了首款触控屏 MacBook Pro（配备 PROLED XDR 显示屏的 MacBook Pro），系列产品 10 月 30 日 9 点接受预购，11 月 6 日发售，22,999 元起，IT之家随附官方商店地址（ 点此访问 ）。 系列笔记本可选 14.2/16.3 英寸版本，前者尺寸为 21.63 厘米 x31.08 厘米 x1.50 厘米，重 1.38 千克；后者尺寸为 24.42 厘米 x35.55 厘米 x1.60 厘米，重 1.82 千克。笔记本 C 面仍配备指纹识别触控 ID，笔记本可选 M5 Pro/M5 Max 芯片（至高可选 M5 Max：18 核中央处理器、16 核神经网络引擎版本），提供至高 24 小时续航。 IT之家获悉，相应屏幕为双层串联 OLED ProMotion 1Hz-120Hz 自适应刷新率触控屏（官方称之为“PROLED XDR 显示屏”），提供 1000 尼特持续全屏亮度、2000 尼特 HDR 和 SDR 峰值亮度，覆盖 P3 + Adobe RGB 广色域。还提供了 iPhone 用户熟悉的“灵动岛”（1200 万像素 Center Stage 摄像头）。 苹果表示，在设计层面，官方将触控传感器直接嵌入显示面板，而非加在表层，这让延迟大大降低，用起来就像是直接在触控内容本身…
items.summary_en: Apple has announced its first touchscreen MacBook Pro, offered in 14.2- and 16.3-inch versions starting at ¥22,999. It features a tandem OLED ProMotion touch display, M5 Pro/M5 Max chips, up to 24 hours of battery life, and a Dynamic Island with a 12MP Center Stage camera. Preorders begin October 30, with sales starting November 6.
items.why_zh: 这是Mac首次引入触控屏，意味着苹果笔记本交互方式和高端屏显方案迎来重要转变。
items.why_en: It marks the Mac's first touchscreen, a significant shift in Apple's laptop interaction and high-end display strategy.

items.title_zh: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 基准上线，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 为 FrontierCode 2.0 开源模型最高成绩
items.title_en: Intelligence Index v5 launches with 60% private-test weighting; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash leads FrontierCode 2.0 among open-source models
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，Artificial Analysis 昨日发布了 Intelligence Index v5，这是该机构自 2026 年 1 月 v4 上线以来幅度最大的一次基准重构。 最直接的变化是，60% 的评测权重首次建立在私有测试集或隐藏答案之上，用于压缩公开题库被模型训练数据“污染”的空间，减少了各厂商为了跑分而跑分的“注水”测试项目。 该指数仍由九项评测构成，包括知识工作、编码、科学、通用能力各占 25%。其中编码 25% 的权重里，Cognition 于同日发布的 FrontierCode 2.0 独占 15%，Terminal-Bench 4.0 占 10%。 其中最值得关注的 FrontierCode 2.0 完全换了一套评分逻辑。132 项任务全部来自真实开源仓库，模型提交的代码改动不再只由单元测试是否通过来判定，而是由该仓库的维护者按“是否愿意合并这个 PR”来打分，任何一项阻塞性检查失败即记零分。 Cognition 在 6 月推出 FrontierCode 初版时就强调，传统基准只检查代码能否跑通，而合并决策还涉及改动范围是否克制、风格是否与代码库一致、回归风险是否可控等测试无法完全覆盖的维度。v5 将这一基准升级到 2.0 并纳入主指数，等于把“可合并性”而非“可运行性”推到了编码能力评价的中心。 在这一口径下，DeepSeek V4…
items.summary_en: Artificial Analysis has launched Intelligence Index v5, rebuilding its benchmark with 60% of evaluation weight based on private test sets or hidden answers to reduce contamination. Coding now carries 25% weight, with FrontierCode 2.0 accounting for 15% and Terminal-Bench 4.0 for 10%. FrontierCode 2.0 scores models on whether maintainers would merge their pull requests, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 leads among open-source models.
items.why_zh: 新基准把编码评价从“能运行”转向“可合并”，并压缩刷分空间，可能更贴近真实开发能力。
items.why_en: By shifting coding evaluation from “runnable” to “mergeable” and reducing benchmark gaming, v5 may better reflect real-world development ability.

items.title_zh: Chrome增强自动填充接入Gmail，可借Gemini建议表单信息
items.title_en: Chrome’s enhanced autofill can now pull info from Gmail to help you fill out forms
items.summary_zh: Chrome的增强自动填充功能进一步扩展：从今天起，它将使用Gemini with Personal Intelligence，从用户的Gmail中提取信息并给出填写建议。此前该功能已可从Google账户及Google Wallet等服务获取姓名、护照号、邮箱地址和物理地址等信息。新增能力可帮助用户查找物流单号、旅行信息、确认邮件、收据或配送更新等内容，减少手动搜索。
items.summary_en: Following improvements made to Chrome's enhanced autofill last year that included your name, passport number , email address, and physical addresses sourced from your Google Accounts and services like Google Wallet, the feature is now expanding. Starting today, Chrome's enhanced autofill will use Gemini with Personal Intelligence to suggest information sourced from your Gmail, potentially saving you from having to search for confirmation emails, receipts, or shipping updates yourself. The expanded autofill capabilities can retrieve details such as a shipment's tracking number, travel details l…
items.why_zh: 浏览器自动填充开始调用个人邮件上下文，既提升表单填写效率，也引发对个人数据使用边界的关注。
items.why_en: Autofill now draws on personal email context, improving form completion while raising questions about personal-data boundaries.

items.title_zh: Alfieholdingslimited 推出 AI 驱动的市场情报与金融分析平台
items.title_en: Alfieholdingslimited Launches AI-Powered Market Intelligence and Financial Analytics Platform
items.summary_zh: Alfieholdingslimited 宣布推出 AI 驱动的市场情报与金融分析平台。现有信息仅披露平台定位，未提及具体功能、定价、上线时间或客户情况。该消息通过雅虎财经发布，显示公司正切入 AI 金融分析工具赛道。
items.summary_en: Alfieholdingslimited Launches AI-Powered Market Intelligence and Financial Analytics Platform Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 该发布为金融数据市场增添了一个 AI 分析平台，反映 AI 正持续渗透市场情报与投资分析场景。
items.why_en: The launch adds another AI-driven analytics offering to the financial data market, reflecting AI's continued push into market intelligence and investment analysis.

items.title_zh: 华为 Mate 90 系列手机十大黑科技汇总，影像、屏幕、性能与通信多重突破
items.title_en: Huawei Mate 90 series debuts with ten breakthroughs across imaging, display, performance and connectivity
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，在今天的华为双十一焕新季 · 全场景新品发布会上，华为董事、终端 BG CEO 何刚登台主讲，揭秘了 Mate 90 系列手机的十大黑科技，实现影像、屏幕、性能与通信多重突破。 设计方面，华为 Mate 90 Pro Max 典藏版采用 钇晶宝石匠心工艺 ：稀土配方（ 45% 钇元素含量 ）、超高硬度（ 1800°C 高温 + 180MPa 高压烧结 ）、高折射率（ 折射率 1.8 高于蓝宝石 ）。 性能方面， Mate 90 系列全新搭载旗舰 τ 芯片 。其中，标准版手机搭载麒麟 9030，整机性能提升 27%；Mate 90 Pro 手机首发麒麟 9035，整机性能提升 20%；Mate 90 Pro Max 典藏版及 RS 非凡大师则搭载首款逻辑折叠 τ 芯片 —— 麒麟 9050 Pro。另外，Mate 90 Pro Max 普通版搭载麒麟 9050。 屏幕方面，在 Mate 90 Pro 系列上，华为带来了第二代灵珑屏， 采用双层 OLED 架构设计、AI Pixel 逐屏逐像素校准，支持麒麟朱雀双芯协同保障屏幕显示效果 。第二代灵珑屏和普通屏幕的最大区别在于其串联了两组发光单元：在相同亮度下，屏幕寿命基本可以翻番；在相同功耗下，可以实现更高的亮度。 另外，Mate 90 Pro Max 所搭载的全彩灵珑屏支持 BT.2020 色域（覆盖…
items.summary_en: At its October 28 launch event, Huawei detailed ten Mate 90 series breakthroughs across imaging, display, performance and connectivity. The lineup includes Kirin 9030/9035/9050 chips, with the Mate 90 Pro Max collector's edition and RS model using the Kirin 9050 Pro logic-folding τ chip, plus a second-generation Linglong dual-layer OLED display with AI pixel calibration.
items.why_zh: Mate 90 系列集中展示华为在芯片、显示和材料工艺上的迭代能力，强化其高端旗舰竞争力。
items.why_en: The Mate 90 series showcases Huawei's iterative capabilities in chips, displays and materials, reinforcing its high-end flagship competitiveness.

items.title_zh: 「豆包工作」上线，AI巨头狂卷办公场景，独立客户端成标配？
items.title_en: Doubao Work launches as AI office productivity race heats up
items.summary_zh: 「豆包工作」上线，AI巨头狂卷办公场景，独立客户端成标配？ 36氪
items.summary_en: 36Kr reports that Doubao Work has launched, bringing Doubao further into AI-powered office productivity. The report frames the move within Big Tech's broader push into workplace scenarios and the question of whether standalone clients are becoming standard for such products.
items.why_zh: 办公场景是AI助手商业化的重要入口，豆包推出独立工作产品将加剧巨头间的生产力工具竞争。
items.why_en: Office productivity is a key commercialization entry point for AI assistants, and Doubao's standalone work product could intensify competition among Big Tech.

items.title_zh: 从 AI 服务器 PCB 到五轴机床，国产工业母机订单已排到明年二季度
items.title_en: From AI server PCBs to five-axis machine tools, Chinese machine tool orders stretch into Q2 next year
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，据央视财经今日报道，国产工业母机订单外溢，部分厂商的订单已经排到明年。 在江苏苏州一家工业母机企业的车间里，一台六轴 PCB 钻孔机已完成组装，正在做发货前的最后测试。企业相关负责人称，今年上半年公司 PCB 主要设备产量较去年同期大幅提高，其中先进系列设备的产量已超过去年全年的两倍，“订单已经排到明年第二季度”。 中国机床工具工业协会 8 月发布的数据显示，2026 年上半年我国机床工具行业完成营业收入 5309 亿元，同比增长 7.6%；利润总额 196 亿元，同比增长 110.8%。 PCB 钻孔机的排产紧张，直接源于 AI 算力基建对高多层板、高阶 HDI 板的加工需求。随着 AI 服务器层数增加、孔径缩小、厚径比上升，传统钻孔设备在精度和效率上逐步触顶。大族数控在 5 月的投资者关系活动中披露，其 CCD 六轴独立机械钻孔机搭载 3D 背钻及钻测一体技术，已通过下一代 AI 服务器 PCB 认证并在多家龙头企业量产。 高端五轴机床的排产情况比 PCB 钻孔机更为紧张。科德数控 2026 年上半年新签订单同比增速近 25%，截至 6 月末在手订单规模达 2.66 亿元，同比增长 64.53%，相关订单预计在 2026 年下半年至 2027 年上半年陆续交付。其五轴整机国产化率超过 90%，核心功能部件自主化率约 85%，自研 GNC62 数…
items.summary_en: CCTV Finance reports that Chinese machine tool makers are seeing order spillover, with one Suzhou company's six-axis PCB drilling machines booked into Q2 next year. AI server demand for high-layer and high-end HDI boards is straining traditional drilling equipment, while high-end five-axis machine tool orders at Kede CNC are scheduled for delivery into 2027.
items.why_zh: AI 算力基建正拉动高端 PCB 设备与五轴机床需求，国产工业母机迎来订单与国产替代的双重窗口。
items.why_en: AI computing infrastructure is driving demand for high-end PCB equipment and five-axis machine tools, creating an order and localization window for Chinese machine tool makers.

items.title_zh: 186 家科创板公司三季报披露：合计营收超 4266 亿元，同比增长 31.54%
items.title_en: 186 STAR Market firms report Q3 revenue of 426.7 billion yuan, up 31.54%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，据央视新闻今日报道，上交所最新数据显示，截至 10 月 27 日，共 186 家科创板公司完成三季报披露，合计营收 4266.76 亿元，同比增长 31.54%， 合计净利润 389.53 亿元，同比增长 57.39% 。其中，14 家科创 50 公司收入、净利润贡献度分别占 29%、47%。 IT之家从报道中获悉，截至 10 月 27 日，已有 14 家科创 50 成分公司披露 2026 年三季报，已披露公司合计实现营业收入 1231.70 亿元、净利润 183.03 亿元，同比分别增长 25.99%、46.17%。以 人工智能、半导体 为代表的科技龙头营收和利润保持较快增长，研发投入、技术突破与国产替代持续推进，相关成果正加快体现在上市公司的收入和利润中。 延伸阅读 文中多次提到的科创板，是上海证券交易所设立的独立于现有主板市场的新设板块。2019 年 1 月 30 日，证监会发布相关实施意见，明确科创板精准定位于“面向世界科技前沿、面向经济主战场、面向国家重大需求”，主要服务于符合国家战略、突破关键核心技术、市场认可度高的科技创新企业，重点支持新一代信息技术、高端装备、新材料、新能源、节能环保以及生物医药等高新技术产业和战略性新兴产业，并试点注册制。科创板于 2019 年 6 月 13 日正式开板。 文中提及的“科创 50”指上证科创板 50…
items.summary_en: As of October 27, 186 STAR Market companies had disclosed Q3 results, reporting combined revenue of 426.676 billion yuan, up 31.54%, and net profit of 38.953 billion yuan, up 57.39%. AI and semiconductor leaders continued to grow fast, with R&D, technology breakthroughs and localization feeding into earnings.
items.why_zh: 科创板三季报显示 AI 与半导体龙头的业绩兑现，反映研发投入和国产替代正转化为实际增长。
items.why_en: The Q3 results show AI and semiconductor leaders converting R&D and localization efforts into earnings growth, a key signal for China's tech-focused STAR Market.

items.title_zh: xAI 被曝收购密西西比居民房屋，要求业主承诺不就数据中心噪音起诉
items.title_en: xAI is buying out homeowners who promise not to sue over data center noise
items.summary_zh: 据《卫报》报道，xAI 子公司提出收购密西西比州 Southaven 社区的部分房屋，条件是居民不加入针对其附近数据中心和发电厂的诉讼。一名挨家挨户拜访的房产经纪告诉居民，xAI 计划购买 418 套房屋，已有 18 名业主打算出售；租户则称已收到 60 天通知、被迫搬离。该事件凸显 AI 数据中心扩张带来的噪音与社区冲突。
items.summary_en: xAI’s Southaven, Mississippi data center. | Photo by Brandon Dill / AFP via Getty Images A subsidiary of Elon Musk's xAI is offering to buy up homes in a Mississippi neighborhood, as long as residents don't join a lawsuit targeting the company's nearby data center and power plant, according to a report from The Guardian . A realtor going door-to-door in the Southaven neighborhood reportedly told one resident that xAI plans to purchase 418 homes, adding that 18 homeowners already have plans to sell. People who rent homes in the area report they're already being forced out , with 60 days' notice…
items.why_zh: 该事件揭示 AI 数据中心快速扩张与社区环境权益之间的冲突，以及企业通过收购房屋规避诉讼的争议做法。
items.why_en: The case highlights the conflict between rapid AI data center expansion and community environmental concerns, as well as controversial efforts to avoid litigation through home purchases.

items.title_zh: 迈克尔·伯里称 Anthropic IPO 故事存在 5370 亿美元漏洞
items.title_en: Michael Burry Finds a $537 Billion Hole in Anthropic’s IPO Story
items.summary_zh: 有报道称，知名投资者迈克尔·伯里（Michael Burry）对 Anthropic 的 IPO 叙事提出质疑，指其中存在 5370 亿美元的“漏洞”。现有信息仅给出这一说法，未披露其测算方法、所指具体资产或估值环节，也未包含 Anthropic 的回应。该质疑出现在 Anthropic 推进上市之际，因而受到市场关注。
items.summary_en: Michael Burry Finds a $537 Billion Hole in Anthropic’s IPO Story TradingView
items.why_zh: 知名投资者的质疑可能影响市场对 Anthropic 上市估值与 AI 资产定价的信心。
items.why_en: Scrutiny from a high-profile investor could affect market confidence in Anthropic's IPO valuation and broader AI asset pricing.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 文件引发昂贵疑问：谁能说不？
items.title_en: Anthropic’s IPO filing raises a costly question: Who can say no?
items.summary_zh: 据 Fortune 报道，Anthropic 的 IPO 文件引发一个“代价高昂”的问题：谁可以说不。报道以此为核心审视其上市安排，但输入信息未展开具体条款、估值、股东权利或监管细节。该问题出现在 Anthropic 推进 IPO 的背景下，外界关注谁对关键事项拥有否决权。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s IPO filing raises a costly question: Who can say no? Fortune
items.why_zh: 对“谁能说不”的追问触及 AI 公司上市中的控制权与治理安排，可能影响投资者判断。
items.why_en: The question of who can say no touches on control and governance in an AI company's IPO, potentially shaping investor views.

items.title_zh: 被禁四年多后《Free Fire》印度本地化版本回归上线，加入游戏时长限制与消费上限
items.title_en: Free Fire India returns after four-year ban with playtime limits and spending caps
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，Garena 于当地时间 10 月 28 日在印度正式推出《Free Fire India》，这是热门大逃杀手游《Free Fire》针对印度市场推出的本地化独立版本，面向安卓和 iOS 平台开放下载。 根据 Garena 官方公告，《Free Fire India》加入了面向印度玩家的本地化游戏内容（例如游戏资源加载页面变成了下图），并提供家长同意机制、游戏时长限制、定期休息提醒和消费上限等功能。 Garena 还表示，该版本针对不同硬件规格的智能手机进行了优化，玩家数据将存储在印度境内的服务器上。 此次上线还包括一项排灯节主题活动，活动将持续至 11 月 15 日。Garena 称，公司在开发过程中与印度相关政府部门合作，并根据对方反馈对游戏进行了调整。 《Free Fire》曾是印度最受欢迎的手游之一。直到 2022 年 2 月，印度政府以国家安全为由，封禁了包括《Free Fire》在内的 54 款应用。此后，Garena 原计划于 2023 年推出印度本地化版本，但在当年 9 月宣布推迟上线，且一直没有公布新的发布时间。 《Free Fire MAX》是画面效果有所升级的版本，并未被列入当年的封禁名单，因此此后仍可在印度使用。Garena 印度业务负责人 Vaibhav Das Mundhra 向 TechCrunch 表示，《Free…
items.summary_en: Garena launched Free Fire India on October 28 as a localized standalone version for Android and iOS, featuring parental consent, playtime limits, rest reminders and spending caps. Player data is stored on servers in India, and Garena says it worked with Indian government departments; Free Fire was banned in the country in February 2022 over national security concerns.
items.why_zh: 该回归显示印度对曾封禁应用采取本地化合规路径，也为游戏出海的内容、数据和未成年人保护合规提供参考。
items.why_en: The return shows a localization-and-compliance path for previously banned apps in India and offers a reference for game makers navigating content, data and minor-protection rules abroad.

items.title_zh: Jedify 正式推出 Data Agents，用自然语言搭建 AI 分析师
items.title_en: Jedify formally launches Data Agents for building AI analysts in plain language
items.summary_zh: Jedify 正式发布 Data Agents 产品，主打让用户以自然语言方式构建自己的“AI 分析师”。按其定位，用户无需编写代码或复杂查询语句，即可用日常语言描述分析需求，由 AI 代理完成数据查询与分析任务。目前公开信息主要来自公司发布，具体客户案例、定价与可用范围尚未披露。该产品指向企业数据分析的“去技术门槛”趋势，即把数据洞察能力从数据团队扩展到业务人员。
items.summary_en: Jedify formally launches Data Agents for building AI analysts in plain language SiliconANGLE
items.why_zh: 自然语言驱动的数据分析代理正成为企业 AI 落地的重要方向，降低使用门槛可能重塑数据团队与业务部门的协作方式。
items.why_en: Natural-language data agents are emerging as a key enterprise AI use case that could lower the barrier to analytics and reshape how data teams work with business units.

items.title_zh: Financial AI startup Casap raises $56 million to help banks stop an explosion of customer fraud
items.title_en: Financial AI startup Casap raises $56 million to help banks stop an explosion of customer fraud
items.summary_zh: Financial AI startup Casap raises $56 million to help banks stop an explosion of customer fraud Fortune
items.summary_en: Financial AI startup Casap has raised $56 million to help banks combat a surge in customer fraud. The company uses AI to help financial institutions detect suspicious activity, a need that is growing as digital banking expands and fraud tactics scale up. Investors and valuation were not detailed in the available summary.
items.why_zh: 银行欺诈规模快速膨胀，使 AI 反欺诈成为金融机构刚需，也解释了资本持续加注该赛道的原因。
items.why_en: Rapid growth in fraud against banks makes AI-driven detection a core need for financial institutions, explaining continued investor interest in the sector.

items.summary_en: Biwin Storage reported first-three-quarter 2026 revenue of 21.717 billion yuan, up 230.3% year over year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 8.768 billion yuan, up 28,728.12%. Gross margin reached 51.42%, while operating cash flow was negative 10.041 billion yuan. Third-quarter net profit rose 525.34% to 1.602 billion yuan, beating market expectations.
items.why_zh: 利润同比增长近 287 倍、毛利率大幅抬升，反映存储行业景气周期与 AI 需求对存储器厂商盈利的巨大拉动。
items.why_en: A nearly 287-fold profit increase and sharply higher gross margin illustrate how the memory upcycle and AI demand can dramatically lift storage makers' earnings.

items.title_zh: 豆包公关负责人刘星：“横店与字节合作，将15万个群演的肖像和声音喂给字节大模型”的传言严重失实
items.title_en: Doubao denies rumor that Hengdian's 150,000 extras were used to train ByteDance's model
items.summary_zh: 豆包公关负责人刘星：“横店与字节合作，将15万个群演的肖像和声音喂给字节大模型”的传言严重失实 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Doubao public relations head Liu Xing said a viral claim that Hengdian cooperated with ByteDance to feed the likenesses and voices of 150,000 extras into its large model is seriously inaccurate. The rumor had raised concerns about portrait and voice rights in AI training data. The company did not provide further details in the response.
items.why_zh: 训练数据来源与肖像、声音授权是 AI 行业的高敏感合规议题，头部平台的公开否认凸显此类传言对品牌与法律风险的冲击。
items.why_en: Training-data sourcing and likeness/voice consent are highly sensitive compliance issues, making such rumors a serious brand and legal risk for major AI platforms.

items.title_zh: Pasqal Launches AI Workflow for Cloud Quantum Experiments
items.title_en: Pasqal Launches AI Workflow for Cloud Quantum Experiments
items.summary_zh: Pasqal Launches AI Workflow for Cloud Quantum Experiments The Quantum Insider
items.summary_en: Quantum computing company Pasqal has launched an AI workflow aimed at cloud-based quantum experiments. The move points to tighter integration of AI tooling into how quantum experiments are designed and run remotely. Details on capabilities and availability were not disclosed in the source summary.
items.why_zh: 将 AI 工作流接入云端量子实验，是量子计算从实验室装置走向可用工具链的一步。
items.why_en: Embedding AI workflows into cloud quantum experiments is a step toward turning quantum hardware into usable tooling.

items.title_zh: 得州选民达成共识：他们讨厌数据中心
items.title_en: Voters in Texas agree: They hate data centers
items.summary_zh: 报道指出，数据中心开发商涌入奥斯汀及周边郊区后，在得州多地遭遇强烈抵制。得州 NAACP 主席 Gary Bledsoe 举例称，泰勒市有人反对在原本规划为公园的地块建数据中心；约 40 英里外的坦普尔市，市长和市议员因数据中心开发面临罢免动议；奥斯汀外约 30 英里的圣马科斯则成为全州首个禁止数据中心的城市。文章认为，这种反对情绪在全球范围内都少见如此集中，反映出 AI 算力扩张与地方社区利益之间的张力。
items.summary_en: Ask Texas NAACP president Gary Bledsoe what it's been like to see data center developers descend upon Austin and its surrounding suburbs and he can rattle off project after project facing opposition from locals. There's the fight in Taylor over plans to build a data center at a site that's supposed to be a park. Temple, around 40 miles away, is another sore spot, Bledsoe says. The mayor and City Council members there face recall attempts over data center developments. And some 30 miles outside of Austin, San Marcos became the first city in all of Texas to ban data centers . Nowhere in the worl…
items.why_zh: AI 算力扩张正把数据中心变成地方政治议题，社区抵制可能直接影响项目的选址、审批与建设进度。
items.why_en: AI compute expansion is turning data centers into local political issues, and community backlash could directly affect siting, permitting and construction timelines.

items.title_zh: e 签宝上线豆包工作：签合同，只需说一句话
items.title_en: eSign launches on Doubao Work: sign contracts with a single sentence
items.summary_zh: e 签宝上线豆包工作：签合同，只需说一句话 新浪财经
items.summary_en: E-signature provider eSign has launched on Doubao Work, ByteDance's AI office product, letting users initiate and complete contract signing through natural-language instructions. The integration shows AI assistants expanding deeper into enterprise workflows by embedding tools like e-signature into a conversational entry point.
items.why_zh: AI 助手正从“回答问题”走向“执行事务”，电子签章接入对话入口是业务流程被 AI 重构的一个具体样本。
items.why_en: AI assistants are shifting from answering questions to executing tasks, and embedding e-signature in a chat interface is a concrete example of business workflows being rebuilt around AI.

items.title_zh: Meta 悄然上线“AI 宠物日记”应用 Waddle World
items.title_en: Meta quietly launched an ‘AI pet journal’ app
items.summary_zh: Meta 推出了一款名为 Waddle World 的“电子宠物”式应用，虚拟小生物会与用户对话，并画涂鸦来图解对话内容。根据其在苹果与 Google Play 商店的页面描述，这款“16 位像素宠物养成游戏”其实并非真正的游戏，而是“伪装成宠物的每日日记”，鼓励用户用说话而非打字的方式与宠物交流，同时提供叠放杂货、文字游戏等轻松玩法。该应用于低调上线，Meta 未做大规模宣传。
items.summary_en: Meta has launched a "tamagotchi-style" pet game called Waddle World, with virtual creatures that chat with users and create doodles to illustrate conversations. According to its Apple and Play Store listings, the "16-bit pet care game" is not really a game, but "a daily journal disguised as a pet." Users should talk, not type, with their pets, the description says, as well as play "cozy games" like stacking groceries or word games. The Play store description says: A little friend that listens. A cozy world that's yours. Waddle World is a cozy 16-bit world where your pixel pet lives. Hatch a vi…
items.why_zh: Meta 以低调方式测试对话式 AI 消费级应用，反映大厂正探索把大模型能力包装成日常陪伴类产品以获取用户数据与使用时长。
items.why_en: Meta's quiet test of a conversational consumer app shows big tech exploring how to package LLM capabilities as everyday companion products to win engagement and data.

items.title_en: Southbound funds net sell HK$800 million, rotate into Zhipu and Innolight, exit Pop Mart

items.summary_en: Southbound funds recorded a net sell of roughly HK$800 million, with money rotating into Zhipu and optical module maker Innolight while flowing out of Pop Mart. The data points to structural repositioning by mainland investors between AI-related and consumer names.
items.why_zh: 南向资金流向是观察港股 AI 与消费板块资金偏好的高频指标，反映内地投资者对相关标的的短期态度变化。
items.why_en: Southbound flows are a high-frequency gauge of mainland investor preference across Hong Kong's AI and consumer sectors, signaling shifts in short-term positioning.

items.summary_en: Inspur said revenue for the first nine months of 2026 reached 129.329 billion yuan, up 7.18% year over year, while net profit attributable to shareholders jumped 165.32% to 3.932 billion yuan. items.why_zh: 营收小幅增长而归母净利润大幅提升，显示这家AI服务器龙头的盈利结构正在变化，是观察AI算力景气度的重要样本。
items.why_en: With revenue up only slightly but profit surging, the results offer a key read on the profitability and demand cycle of AI server infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 宇树科技上市后首份财报公布：2026 年前三季度归母净利润 3.87 亿元，同比增长 270.54%

items.summary_en: Unitree's first earnings report since listing shows revenue of 1.817 billion yuan for the first nine months of 2026, up 55.71%, and net profit of 387 million yuan, up 270.54%. However, non-recurring net profit fell 18.78% and operating cash flow dropped 54.69%, while third-quarter net profit declined 17.37% year over year.
items.why_zh: 作为人形与四足机器人代表企业的首份上市财报，其收入高增但扣非利润和现金流承压，为判断机器人商业化进度提供参照。
items.why_en: As the first post-IPO report from a leading humanoid and quadruped robot maker, it shows fast revenue growth alongside pressure on core profit and cash flow, a key gauge of robot commercialization.

items.title_zh: 图级异常检测评测存漏洞：用测试标签挑模型会高估性能
items.title_en: What Remains Without Leaking Test Labels? Exposing Evaluation Flaws in Graph-Level Anomaly Detection
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文对图级异常检测（GLAD）的公开代码进行审计。这类任务常用于分子筛选等场景，通常只用正常图训练。作者指出，部分检测器在模型选择环节使用了测试标签，仅凭高分并不能证明模型真正识别出结构变化。研究对比了同一训练过程中“用测试标签挑选”与“不用测试标签挑选”的检查点（checkpoint）的 AUROC，并另行比较了针对测试集调参的超参数设置带来的差异。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24045v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph-level anomaly detection (GLAD) identifies unusual graphs in applications such as molecular screening, often using only normal graphs for training. Yet the evaluations of some detectors select models with test labels, and high benchmark scores alone do not show whether detectors recognize structural changes. We audit released code and compare the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) for model states (checkpoints) chosen with and without test labels from the same training run. We separately compare test-tuned hyp…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了异常检测基准分数可能被评测流程本身“注水”，提醒研究者在模型选择环节严格隔离测试标签。
items.why_en: It warns that benchmark scores in anomaly detection may be inflated by the evaluation pipeline itself, urging strict isolation of test labels during model selection.

items.title_zh: 国泰海通：Kimi K3.1 Pro发布看好开源模型生态繁荣带动AI应用加速落地_券商最新研判
items.title_en: Guotai Haitong: Kimi K3.1 Pro Launch Seen Boosting Open-Source Ecosystem and AI Adoption
items.summary_zh: 国泰海通：Kimi K3.1 Pro发布看好开源模型生态繁荣带动AI应用加速落地_券商最新研判 证券之星
items.summary_en: Brokerage Guotai Haitong commented on the release of Kimi K3.1 Pro, arguing that a thriving open-source model ecosystem will accelerate the deployment of AI applications. The note offers a research view on model iteration and industry adoption, with few additional details disclosed.
items.why_zh: 券商把开源大模型的新版本视为 AI 应用落地的催化剂，反映资本市场对开源路线商业价值的关注度上升。
items.why_en: The brokerage treats a new open-source model release as a catalyst for AI application adoption, reflecting growing investor attention to the commercial value of open-source routes.

items.title_zh: Anthropic冲刺万亿级IPO引共振 智谱涨近9%领跑市场
items.title_en: Anthropic's Trillion-Yuan-Scale IPO Push Lifts AI Stocks, Zhipu Jumps Nearly 9%
items.summary_zh: Anthropic冲刺万亿级IPO引共振 智谱涨近9%领跑市场 财联社
items.summary_en: A Caixin-affiliated report says news of Anthropic's push toward a trillion-yuan-scale IPO sparked a broader rally in AI-related names, with Zhipu gaining nearly 9% to lead the sector. Details on valuation, timetable and underwriting were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 头部大模型公司的上市进程被视为 AI 资本化的风向标，也直接影响二级市场对 AI 概念的情绪。
items.why_en: The IPO progress of a leading model developer is seen as a bellwether for AI capitalization and directly shapes sentiment toward AI stocks.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 公布三项“重大”科学发现，并推出与学术界合作新方式
items.title_en: OpenAI announces three big science discoveries and a new way to work with academics
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布在数学、计算机科学和物理三个领域取得三项“重大”发现，并同步公布了一套与学术界协作的新方式。与此前一次性放出数百篇声称解决长期数学问题的手稿不同，这次 OpenAI 让外部专家以“shepherds（引导者）”身份参与把关计算机科学和物理方向的成果；至于数学问题，专家建议直接公开 AI 的输出，由研究者自行梳理并给出解释。相关结果已于当天发布到 GitHub，其中包含标题以“Local smoothing for the Euclidean wa…”开头的一份材料（原文截断）。
items.summary_en: Less than a month after its mass release of hundreds of manuscripts that it said contained solutions to long-standing mathematics questions, OpenAI is back with three more "major" discoveries in math, computer science, and physics . What's different this time is the choice to have external experts that OpenAI describes as "shepherds" guiding the results in computer science and physics, while for the math problem it says that they advised it to release the AI output for researchers to work through their own explanations. OpenAI results added to GitHub today: Local smoothing for the Euclidean wa…
items.why_zh: OpenAI 是否以及如何让外部专家验证 AI 产出的科研成果，直接关系到“AI 做科学”的可信度。
items.why_en: Whether and how OpenAI lets outside experts vet AI-generated research bears directly on the credibility of "AI doing science."

items.title_zh: 达摩达兰谈Anthropic IPO：估值该如何看？
items.title_en: TheAnthropic IPO Arrives: My (but not) the Anthropic Valuation!
items.summary_zh: 估值学者Aswath Damodaran在Substack发文，围绕Anthropic IPO的到来讨论其估值问题。标题显示，文章将给出作者自己的估值视角，而非简单复述市场对Anthropic的估值。摘要未披露具体估值数字或IPO条款，更多内容需参见原文。
items.summary_en: TheAnthropic IPO Arrives: My (but not) the Anthropic Valuation! Aswath Damodaran | Substack
items.why_zh: Anthropic是头部AI公司，其IPO估值讨论将为理解AI独角兽的商业模式与定价提供重要参照。
items.why_en: Anthropic is a leading AI company, and its IPO valuation debate offers a key reference for pricing AI unicorns and their business models.

items.title_zh: Plato 完成 1600 万美元 A 轮融资，开发 AI 培训模拟
items.title_en: Plato Raises $16M Series A to Develop AI Training Simulations
items.summary_zh: 据 citybiz 报道，Plato 宣布完成 1600 万美元 A 轮融资。公司计划将资金用于开发 AI 培训模拟产品，帮助用户通过模拟场景进行训练。报道未披露本轮投资方、具体产品形态或客户信息。此次融资反映出市场对 AI 驱动培训与仿真工具的持续关注。
items.summary_en: Plato Raises $16M Series A to Develop AI Training Simulations citybiz
items.why_zh: AI 培训模拟正成为企业学习和仿真训练的一个投资方向。
items.why_en: AI training simulations are emerging as an investment category for enterprise learning and simulation.

items.title_zh: 苹果首度为 Mac 引入灵动岛：支持显示音乐播放、实时活动等，Siri AI 多了个入口
items.title_en: Apple Brings Dynamic Island to Mac for the First Time
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，苹果公司今日推出首款触控屏 MacBook Pro，提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸两种型号。值得注意的是，这款笔记本支持灵动岛，可将实时活动、聚焦搜索和 Siri AI 整合到屏幕上方交互，这也是苹果首次为 Mac 电脑引入灵动岛。 IT之家了解到，苹果公司最早在 2022 年 9 月的 iPhone 14 Pro 系列推出灵动岛。它在苹果手机中取代了刘海设计，摄像头开孔相比原来更小，还能够通过软件界面显示实时活动、音乐播放、计时器等各类控件。 而 Mac 上的灵动岛支持接听电话、控制音乐播放，以及显示隔空投送请求等， 还能够作为聚焦搜索和 Siri AI 的交互入口 。 不过新款 MacBook Pro 仍然采用触控 ID ，并配备 1200 万像素 Center Stage 摄像头。
items.summary_en: Apple has introduced its first touchscreen MacBook Pro in 14- and 16-inch models, bringing the Dynamic Island to Mac for the first time. The Mac version supports live activities, music controls, AirDrop requests, and acts as an entry point for Spotlight and Siri AI. The feature originally debuted on the iPhone 14 Pro in 2022.
items.why_zh: 这标志着苹果将 iPhone 的交互范式延伸到 Mac，并强化 Siri AI 的系统入口。
items.why_en: It marks Apple extending an iPhone interaction paradigm to the Mac and strengthening Siri AI's system-level entry point.

items.title_zh: 等不及 Anthropic IPO？巴伦周刊称可关注两只 ETF
items.title_en: If You Can’t Wait for Anthropic’s IPO, Buy One of These Two ETFs
items.summary_zh: 《巴伦周刊》刊文讨论，在 Anthropic 尚未 IPO 的情况下，投资者可通过两只 ETF 获得对其的间接敞口。文章以“如果你等不及 Anthropic 的 IPO”为切入点，面向希望提前布局该公司的投资者。报道摘要未说明这两只 ETF 的具体名称和持仓细节。
items.summary_en: If You Can’t Wait for Anthropic’s IPO, Buy One of These Two ETFs Barron's
items.why_zh: AI 明星公司上市前，围绕间接投资工具的讨论凸显市场对 Pre-IPO 敞口的需求。
items.why_en: Before a high-profile AI company goes public, discussion of indirect vehicles highlights demand for pre-IPO exposure.

items.title_zh: WSJ 独家：博通 CEO 介入敲定 630 亿美元 Anthropic 债务交易
items.title_en: Exclusive | Broadcom CEO Intervened to Seal $63 Billion Anthropic Debt Deal
items.summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》独家报道称，博通（Broadcom）CEO 亲自介入，推动敲定了一笔规模达 630 亿美元的 Anthropic 债务交易。报道将这笔交易描述为重大融资安排，并强调博通高层的直接参与。摘要未披露交易的具体结构、债权人或资金用途。
items.summary_en: Exclusive | Broadcom CEO Intervened to Seal $63 Billion Anthropic Debt Deal WSJ
items.why_zh: 如此规模的 AI 相关债务融资凸显芯片与基础设施厂商同头部模型公司之间日益紧密的利益绑定。
items.why_en: A debt deal of this scale highlights the deepening ties between chip and infrastructure players and leading AI model companies.

items.title_zh: 大型银行为何收紧代理式 AI 应用
items.title_en: Why Major Banks Are Reining in Agentic AI
items.summary_zh: 《Global Finance Magazine》报道称，多家大型银行正在收紧对“代理式 AI”（agentic AI）的使用。文章聚焦银行在采用可自主执行任务的 AI 系统时面临的治理、合规与风险控制问题。报道标题表明，金融机构正从积极试验转向更谨慎地限定应用范围。
items.summary_en: Why Major Banks Are Reining in Agentic AI Global Finance Magazine
items.why_zh: 银行对代理式 AI 的审慎态度，反映出金融业在创新效率与可控风险之间的权衡。
items.why_en: Banks' caution around agentic AI reflects the industry's balance between innovation and controllable risk.

items.title_zh: 当客户的 AI 成为交易对手：代理对代理世界中的银行
items.title_en: When the Client's AI Becomes the Counterparty: Banking in an Agent-to-Agent World
items.summary_zh: IBM 发文探讨“当客户的 AI 成为交易对手”这一情景：在代理对代理（agent-to-agent）的世界里，银行客户可能由 AI 代理代为发起交易或交互。文章关注银行如何识别、授权和风控这类非人类交易对手，以及身份验证、责任归属和合规等问题。随着代理式 AI 进入金融场景，银行的基础设施与规则需要相应调整。
items.summary_en: When the Client's AI Becomes the Counterparty: Banking in an Agent-to-Agent World IBM
items.why_zh: 代理式 AI 若代表客户进行交易，将改变银行对交易对手身份、授权和责任的认定方式。
items.why_en: If agentic AI transacts on behalf of clients, it will change how banks identify, authorize and assign responsibility to counterparties.

items.title_zh: Breakingviews 评论：Anthropic 的 IPO 全在于无视未来
items.title_en: Breakingviews - COMMENTARY: Anthropic’s IPO is all about ignoring the future
items.summary_zh: 路透 Breakingviews 评论文章以“Anthropic 的 IPO 全在于无视未来”为题，对 Anthropic 的上市叙事提出质疑。文章属于评论观点，讨论焦点是 IPO 所反映的估值与未来预期之间的关系。摘要未展开具体财务数据或估值模型。
items.summary_en: Breakingviews - COMMENTARY: Anthropic’s IPO is all about ignoring the future Reuters
items.why_zh: 高关注度 AI 公司的 IPO 叙事往往放大估值与未来预期之间的张力，值得投资者审视。
items.why_en: The IPO narrative of a high-profile AI company amplifies tensions between valuation and future expectations, warranting investor scrutiny.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 全在于无视未来
items.title_en: Anthropic’s IPO is all about ignoring the future
items.summary_zh: TradingView 页面以“Anthropic 的 IPO 全在于无视未来”为题，呈现相关评论观点。文章讨论 Anthropic 上市叙事中关于未来预期与当前估值之间的张力。该标题与路透 Breakingviews 评论一致，内容侧重观点分析而非交易细节。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s IPO is all about ignoring the future TradingView
items.why_zh: 围绕 Anthropic 上市的评论观点，提醒读者区分 IPO 叙事中的预期成分与可验证事实。
items.why_en: Commentary around Anthropic's listing reminds readers to separate expectations in the IPO narrative from verifiable facts.

items.title_zh: 智谱与MiniMax，等来最强参照系
items.title_en: Zhipu and MiniMax Get Their 'Strongest Benchmark' Yet
items.summary_zh: 智谱与MiniMax，等来最强参照系 新浪财经
items.summary_en: A Sina Finance article argues that Chinese model developers Zhipu and MiniMax now have their "strongest benchmark" for comparison. The piece frames the two companies' positioning in the industry and capital markets; the available excerpt does not detail specific figures.
items.why_zh: 随着大模型公司竞逐资本市场，谁来充当估值与能力的参照系，正成为判断行业格局的关键。
items.why_en: As Chinese model developers race toward public markets, the choice of benchmark is becoming central to how industry leaders are valued.

items.title_zh: 15 万名群演肖像声音喂给大模型？豆包辟谣15万群演数据喂模型
items.title_en: Doubao Denies Claims That 150,000 Extras' Faces and Voices Were Used to Train AI
items.summary_zh: 15 万名群演肖像声音喂给大模型？豆包辟谣15万群演数据喂模型 finance.sina.com.cn
items.summary_en: Doubao, ByteDance's AI assistant, has publicly denied viral claims that the likenesses and voices of 150,000 film extras were fed into a large model for training. The denial, reported by Sina Finance, comes amid growing scrutiny of how AI training data is sourced and whether personal rights are respected.
items.why_zh: 训练数据来源是否合法，已成为大模型厂商必须公开回应的议题。
items.why_en: Data provenance is now a public accountability issue that every model developer must address head-on.

items.title_zh: 明尼苏达大学报告警告：学生使用 AI 对学习构成“严重”威胁
items.title_en: University of Minnesota report warns student AI use poses 'severe' threat to learning
items.summary_zh: 明尼苏达大学发布的一份报告警告称，学生在学习过程中使用 AI 工具，可能对学习本身构成“严重”威胁。据 MPR News 报道，报告关注的是 AI 介入后学生的认知投入与学习效果面临下滑的风险，而非单纯的技术禁令问题。这一结论为高校如何制定 AI 使用政策增添了新的争议焦点。
items.summary_en: University of Minnesota report warns student AI use poses 'severe' threat to learning MPR News
items.why_zh: 当 AI 进入课堂，教育界需要在效率工具与真实学习之间重新界定边界。
items.why_en: As AI enters the classroom, educators must redraw the line between helpful tooling and genuine learning.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 递交万亿美元级 IPO 申请，S-1 披露 Claude 成本
items.title_en: Anthropic filed for a trillion-dollar IPO. The S-1 shows what Claude costs.
items.summary_zh: 据 Vocal 报道，Anthropic 已递交 IPO 申请，规模被形容为“万亿美元级”，其 S-1 文件同时披露了 Claude 模型的成本结构。招股书中的成本信息，让外界首次得以从财务角度观察这家 AI 公司的运营方式。对于关注大模型商业模式的人来说，这些数据是判断 AI 产品能否盈利的重要线索。
items.summary_en: Anthropic filed for a trillion-dollar IPO. The S-1 shows what Claude costs. Vocal
items.why_zh: AI 公司的成本与盈利结构长期不透明，招股书让外界第一次能看清这笔账。
items.why_en: The economics of AI model builders have long been opaque; an S-1 finally puts real numbers on the table.

items.title_zh: 参议员沃伦要求 Anthropic CEO 在 IPO 前回应“生存性风险”
items.title_en: Sen. Elizabeth Warren asks Anthropic CEO to address ex­is­tential risks before IPO
items.summary_zh: 据 Spectrum News 报道，美国参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦致函 Anthropic CEO，要求其在公司 IPO 之前就 AI 可能带来的“生存性风险”作出回应。此举显示，随着头部 AI 公司走向公开市场，立法者对模型安全与治理的审视正在加强。对 Anthropic 而言，监管问询可能成为其上市进程中的额外变量。
items.summary_en: Sen. Elizabeth Warren asks Anthropic CEO to address ex­is­tential risks before IPO Spectrum News
items.why_zh: AI 安全议题正从技术讨论进入资本市场与立法议程。
items.why_en: AI safety is moving from technical debate into capital markets and the legislative agenda.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 在即，沃伦警告“美国人可能接盘”
items.title_en: Ahead of Anthropic IPO, Warren Warns AI Giant Could Leave 'Americans Holding the Bag'
items.summary_zh: 在美国 AI 公司 Anthropic 启动 IPO 之际，参议员沃伦（Warren）公开警告称，这家 AI 巨头上市可能让普通美国人承担风险、最终“接盘”。已公开的摘要未提供沃伦的具体指控细节，也未包含 Anthropic 方面的回应。这一表态把 AI 公司的高估值与上市进程推到监管和公众审视的聚光灯下。
items.summary_en: Ahead of Anthropic IPO, Warren Warns AI Giant Could Leave 'Americans Holding the Bag' Common Dreams
items.why_zh: 立法者在 AI 巨头上市前的公开质疑，可能影响投资者情绪，并左右这一赛道的监管讨论。
items.why_en: Public criticism from a lawmaker ahead of a major AI IPO could sway investor sentiment and shape regulation of the sector.

items.title_zh: 短短一周时间里 B站被DeepSeek狠狠入侵了
items.title_en: Bilibili Flooded With DeepSeek Content Within a Week
items.summary_zh: 短短一周时间里 B站被DeepSeek狠狠入侵了 驱动之家
items.summary_en: Chinese outlet Mydrivers reports that Bilibili was overrun with DeepSeek-related content within a single week. Specific figures and content formats were not disclosed in the available summary. The episode highlights how quickly domestic large models spread through youth-oriented online communities.
items.why_zh: 年轻用户社区的自发传播，是观察国产大模型真实渗透率的一个直观切面。
items.why_en: Organic virality on youth-oriented platforms offers a direct read on how deeply domestic AI models are penetrating everyday users.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 文件披露：台积电并非总能足量供应芯片
items.title_en: Anthropic's IPO Filing Says TSMC Couldn't Always Supply Enough Chips
items.summary_zh: 据 Forbes 报道，Anthropic 在 IPO 申报文件中提到，台积电并非始终能够提供足够数量的芯片。作为依赖大规模算力训练模型的 AI 公司，先进制程产能的紧张可能影响其模型研发与产品交付节奏。这一披露把芯片供应列为需要向投资者说明的潜在风险，也让外界更清楚地看到头部 AI 公司对少数晶圆代工产能的高度依赖。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's IPO Filing Says TSMC Couldn't Always Supply Enough Chips Forbes
items.why_zh: 招股文件罕见地把芯片供应瓶颈写入风险因素，凸显算力供应链对头部大模型公司的硬约束。
items.why_en: It is notable that a prospectus explicitly lists chip supply bottlenecks as a risk, underscoring how tightly compute supply constrains leading AI labs.

items.title_zh: Meta 称可能再次推迟争议性商业条款
items.title_en: Meta says it’ll probably delay its controversial new business terms again
items.summary_zh: Meta 通讯主管 Andy Stone 在 X 上表示，公司“不打算在没有与行业团体和领导者充分协商的情况下做出政策变更”，暗示原定 10 月 30 日生效的新商业条款可能推迟到 11 月 20 日之后。这些条款最初被解读为允许 Meta 使用 Facebook 和 Instagram 上新闻网站的内容训练 AI 模型，随后公司修改政策，删除了可能“训练”相关表述。此举发生在出版商就 AI 训练用途强烈反弹之后。
items.summary_en: Meta says it may push the implementation of its new business terms past November 20th as it faces backlash from publishers over concerns about AI training. In a post on X , Meta communications head Andy Stone said the company does "not plan to make policy changes without a full consultation with industry groups and leaders." The new business terms, which were supposed to take effect on October 30th, initially appeared to give Meta permission to train its AI models on the news sites that use Facebook and Instagram. Meta later changed its policies to remove language indicating that it could "tra…
items.why_zh: 这场拉锯显示内容平台与出版商在 AI 训练数据授权上的博弈，结果将决定新闻内容能否被用于模型训练。
items.why_en: The standoff shows the bargaining over AI training data between platforms and publishers, and its outcome will shape whether news content feeds AI models.

items.title_zh: 看好 Anthropic 却不想等到 IPO？MarketWatch 梳理当下可参与路径
items.title_en: Bullish on Anthropic but don’t want to wait until the IPO? Here’s how you can invest today.
items.summary_zh: MarketWatch 刊文回应投资者关切：如果看好 Anthropic，但不愿等到其 IPO 之后再入场，眼下有哪些方式可以间接参与。文章属于投资路径梳理类内容，原文摘要未给出具体标的、工具或收益数据。此类间接投资在流动性、估值折溢价与风险敞口上与直接持股存在明显差异，投资者需自行判断。
items.summary_en: Bullish on Anthropic but don’t want to wait until the IPO? Here’s how you can invest today. MarketWatch
items.why_zh: 热门 AI 公司上市前的“曲线投资”需求上升，折射出散户对 AI 资产的高涨热情与随之而来的风险。
items.why_en: Demand for pre-IPO workarounds to invest in hot AI companies reflects both retail enthusiasm for AI assets and the risks that come with it.

items.title_zh: AI 还是气候危机会终结人类？我们可以让两者都不发生
items.title_en: Will it be AI or the climate crisis that ends humanity? We can make it neither | Adam McKay and Philip Eubanks
items.summary_zh: 《卫报》刊发 Adam McKay 与 Philip Eubanks 的评论文章，围绕“AI 还是气候危机会终结人类”这一设问展开。文章主张，人类并非只能在两者之间等待一种灾难发生，而是可以通过选择与行动让两种结局都不发生。作者把人工智能风险与气候危机并置讨论，强调未来不是宿命，而是取决于当下的人类决策。文章呼吁读者正视这两种生存风险，但不要接受其中任何一种作为必然归宿。
items.summary_en: Will it be AI or the climate crisis that ends humanity? We can make it neither | Adam McKay and Philip Eubanks The Guardian
items.why_zh: 文章提醒读者，AI 与气候风险并非命中注定的结局，而是需要人类主动应对的选择。
items.why_en: It reminds readers that existential risks are not inevitabilities but challenges shaped by human choices.

items.title_zh: AI 应用会在未经许可的情况下动你的钱吗？银行正制定新规拦截
items.title_en: Are AI apps moving your money without permission? They could be, and banks are having to put new rules in to block them
items.summary_zh: 雅虎财经报道，一些 AI 应用可能在未获授权的情况下动用用户资金，银行正因此制定新规以拦截此类行为。文章以设问方式提醒用户关注 AI 应用与金融账户之间的权限边界。报道聚焦的是 AI 应用接入金融服务后带来的新型安全与合规问题。对用户而言，这意味着在授权 AI 工具访问支付或账户信息时需要更加谨慎。
items.summary_en: Are AI apps moving your money without permission? They could be, and banks are having to put new rules in to block them Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 它揭示了 AI 应用接入金融账户后可能出现的新型资金安全与授权风险。
items.why_en: It highlights emerging financial-security and authorization risks as AI apps gain access to accounts and payments.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude for Legal Artifacts，深入法律科技栈

items.title_zh: AI 高管可能太脱节，难以真正为大众造产品

items.why_en: It questions whether insulated AI leaders can build products that genuinely serve ordinary users.

items.title_zh: V社详解 Steam 新品节游戏推荐机制：活动刚开始时随机展示，算法会在两天后启用
items.title_en: Valve Explains Steam Next Fest Recommendations: Random for First Two Days, Algorithm After
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，据游戏媒体 VGC 今天报道，Valve 最近在韩国举办 Steam Indie Connect 活动，与游戏开发者交流。有参会者现场抱怨，Steam 新品节的曝光度不佳，并且部分玩家也认为，该活动充斥着大量“AI 垃圾”游戏。 Valve 商务团队成员 Marc Wilkinson 对此表示，Steam 活动开始后的前两天， 玩家在主页看到的游戏是纯随机推荐的 。两天过后，系统才会启用个性化推荐算法，将玩家更感兴趣的游戏展示在首页。 这名V社员工认为，许多玩家针对低质量游戏的批评集中在活动刚开始。他解释道， 之所以在前两天随机展示游戏 ， 是为了让每位开发者都能获得公平的曝光机会 ，同时防止部分人士通过提前参展获取曝光。 他还补充道：“我们知道这种做法会有一定代价，那就是质量差的游戏也会获得曝光。我们完全了解这一情况，目前已经有大量人员在思考如何解决。” 另一名V社员工 Tom Giardino 表示，类似的抱怨并不新鲜。过去也曾有用户要求 Steam 提供屏蔽特定游戏推荐功能。14 年前 Steam Greenlight 上线时，就有开发者询问能否过滤掉这类游戏。之后 Steam Direct 系统出现时，情况也差不多。 不过 Giardino 认为，Valve 的目标并不是过滤掉劣质游戏。 与其限制开发者进入平台 ，不如改进商店， 让更优秀的…
items.summary_en: At Steam Indie Connect in Korea, Valve responded to complaints about poor exposure in Steam Next Fest. Valve's Marc Wilkinson said games are shown randomly on the homepage for the first two days before personalized recommendation algorithms kick in, aiming to give every developer a fair chance and prevent early-participation advantages. Tom Giardino added that such complaints are not new and that Valve aims to improve the store rather than filter out low-quality games.
items.why_zh: 它说明 Steam 如何在独立游戏公平曝光、算法推荐与低质量及 AI 生成内容争议之间做平衡。
items.why_en: It shows how Steam balances fair discoverability for indie games with algorithmic curation and concerns about low-quality or AI-generated content.

items.title_en: Musk's xAI Offers to Buy Homes Near Noisy Data Center, Requiring Residents to Waive Claims
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，据《卫报》今日报道，埃隆 · 马斯克旗下 xAI 正通过子公司 MZX Tech 向美国密西西比州南海文市（Southaven）部分居民提出房屋收购邀约。 根据居民收到的信件，房主接受收购后，需要签署协议，放弃与当地发电厂噪声相关的索赔权利，包括参与针对该公司的集体诉讼的权利。 一名房地产经纪人在当地挨家挨户接洽居民时提到，xAI 的收购目标为 418 套房屋，目前已有至少 18 名房主同意出售。 密西西比自由新闻（Mississippi Free Press）9 月报道称，部分居民收到了 MZX Tech 发出的收购信。MZX 在信中否认针对公司的所有指控，同时通过房地产经纪人提出收购房产的方案。 信件明确指出，签署相关协议后，房主将无法再就南海文发电厂相关问题提出索赔，也不能继续参与由居民发起的集体诉讼。信中没有披露具体收购价格。根据《密西西比自由新闻》的报道，部分居民称其收购报价似乎参考了 Zillow 等房地产网站上的房产估值。 这场纠纷源于当地居民对 xAI 数据中心配套燃气发电设施噪声和振动的投诉。今年 6 月，三名居民起诉 xAI、MZX Tech 等相关公司，指控其运营的燃气发电设施持续产生噪声和振动，影响附近居民的生活质量及房产价值，寻求经济赔偿，并要求采取措施减少相关影响。 部分租户也受到房屋收购计划影响。《卫报》报道称，有租户…
items.summary_en: xAI, via subsidiary MZX Tech, has offered to buy homes in Southaven, Mississippi, from residents who complained about noise from a gas-fired power plant serving its data center, with a target of 418 homes and at least 18 owners agreeing, The Guardian reported. Homeowners who accept must waive claims related to the plant's noise, including participation in a class action; three residents sued xAI and MZX Tech in June. The letters did not disclose prices, and some residents said offers appeared based on Zillow estimates.
items.why_zh: 这凸显 AI 数据中心扩张与社区环境权益的冲突，以及企业以房产收购换取放弃索赔的争议做法。
items.why_en: It highlights tensions between AI data-center expansion and community environmental concerns, as well as the controversial practice of buying homes in exchange for waiving claims.

items.title_zh: 华为 Mate 90 Pro 系列手机第二代灵珑屏技术揭秘：双层 OLED 架构、支持麒麟朱雀双芯协同
items.title_en: Huawei Details Mate 90 Pro's Second-Gen Linglong Display: Dual-Layer OLED, AI Pixel Calibration and Dual-Chip Collaboration
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，在今天下午的华为双十一焕新季 · 全场景新品发布会上，华为董事、终端 BG CEO 何刚揭秘了 Mate 90 Pro 系列手机第二代灵珑屏的技术亮点。核心有三，分别是： 双层 OLED 架构、AI Pixel 逐屏逐像素校准，以及麒麟朱雀双芯协同 。 据介绍，第二代灵珑屏采用双层 OLED 架构，和普通屏幕的最大区别在于其串联了两组发光单元： 在相同亮度下，屏幕寿命基本可以翻番；在相同功耗下，可以实现更高的亮度 。 IT之家注意到，第二代灵珑屏支持麒麟朱雀双芯协同保障屏幕清晰透亮，并可以实现双引擎无缝交接： 麒麟芯片： 低亮度下实现更高精度校准 ； 朱雀显示芯片： 高亮度下实现更低功耗校准 。 另外，华为 Mate 90 Pro Max 所搭载的全彩灵珑屏 支持 BT.2020 色域（覆盖度 95%）和 Pointer 色域（覆盖度 99%）显示 ，色域覆盖对比 P3 色域提升 30%。 何刚提到，很多超出 P3 色域的色彩普通手机无法正常显示，而 Mate 90 Pro Max 的屏幕则可以正常显示。 相关阅读： 《 华为何刚揭秘 Mate 90 系列手机十大黑科技之 τ 芯片，逻辑折叠再次带来性能跨越式提升 》
items.summary_en: At Huawei's event, terminal BG CEO He Gang detailed the second-generation Linglong display on the Mate 90 Pro series. It uses a dual-layer OLED architecture with two light-emitting units, supports AI Pixel per-screen per-pixel calibration, and pairs Kirin and Zhuque chips for low-brightness precision and high-brightness power efficiency. The Mate 90 Pro Max's full-color version covers 95% of BT.2020 and 99% of Pointer, a 30% improvement over P3.
items.why_zh: 显示架构、AI 校准与自研双芯协同共同提升屏幕寿命、亮度和色彩，强化华为高端机的差异化卖点。
items.why_en: The display architecture, AI calibration and dual-chip collaboration improve lifespan, brightness and color, strengthening Huawei's premium smartphone differentiation.

items.title_zh: 苹果 iOS 27.2 更新照片应用：共享相簿新增四项功能
items.title_en: Apple iOS 27.2 updates Photos with four Shared Albums features
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 28 日消息，苹果于当地时间 10 月 26 日发布了最新的 iOS 27.2，为 iPhone 照片应用带来两项新改进，涉及共享相簿功能和 AI 生成或编辑图像的识别能力。 据 9to5mac 今日报道，用户现在可以编辑共享相簿中的照片说明和评论、避免重复添加照片，并在相簿即将到期前收到提醒；系统还新增了对 SynthID 数字水印的支持，以帮助识别使用生成式 AI 创建或修改的图像。 共享相簿是苹果照片应用中的照片和视频分享功能。升级至 iOS 27.2 后，用户可以修改已发布照片和视频的说明文字，也可以编辑评论。 此外，系统能够帮助用户避免向相簿重复添加相同照片，并在共享相簿即将到期时显示提醒，让参与者有机会提前保存其中的照片和视频。要使用这些功能，共享相簿需要升级至适用于 iOS 27 的版本。 另一项更新是支持 SynthID 水印，用于辅助识别图像是否由生成式工具创建或修改。SynthID 是谷歌开发的数字水印技术，可将人眼通常无法直接察觉的标记嵌入 AI 生成或编辑的内容中。用户不会看到传统意义上的可见水印，但可以通过支持该技术的检测工具检查图像是否包含相关标记。 根据苹果的更新说明，iOS 27.2 为照片应用和 Image Playground 图乐园增加了 SynthID 水印支持。不过，这并不意味着所有经过编辑的照片都会带有该标记。苹果此前…
items.summary_en: Apple released iOS 27.2, adding Shared Albums improvements such as editable captions and comments, duplicate prevention and expiry reminders. The Photos app and Image Playground now support Google’s SynthID watermark to help identify AI-generated or edited images, though not all edited photos will carry the mark.
items.why_zh: 把AI内容标识能力带入系统级照片应用，有助于提升生成式图像的可追溯性。
items.why_en: Bringing AI-content watermarking into a system-level photos app can improve the traceability of generated images.

items.title_zh: Foundry 融资1亿美元，推进自主工厂
items.title_en: Foundry Raises $100 Million for Autonomous Factories
items.summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，Foundry 完成1亿美元融资，资金将用于推进自主工厂/无人化工厂方向。报道未披露投资方、估值及具体客户等细节。该融资显示，面向制造业自动化的AI与机器人方案仍在吸引资本关注。
items.summary_en: Foundry Raises $100 Million for Autonomous Factories The Information
items.why_zh: 大额融资表明自主工厂与制造业自动化仍是AI投资热点。
items.why_en: The large raise shows autonomous factories and manufacturing automation remain hot areas for AI investment.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 申报文件提示法律风险，Claude 顾问服务扩张
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO filing flags legal risks as Claude advisor offering expands
items.summary_zh: 据 InvestmentNews 报道，Anthropic 的 IPO 申报文件提示了相关法律风险，同时其 Claude 顾问类服务产品正在扩展。报道未在摘要中展开具体风险类型、业务规模或上市时间表。该动向反映出AI公司在推进上市与商业化过程中，法律合规问题正受到更多审视。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO filing flags legal risks as Claude advisor offering expands InvestmentNews
items.why_zh: IPO进程中的法律风险披露，可能影响市场对AI公司合规与商业模式的评估。
items.why_en: Legal-risk disclosures in the IPO process could affect how markets assess AI companies’ compliance and business models.

items.title_zh: Urban Outfitters 借助AI提升产品开发可见度
items.title_en: Urban Outfitters Inc. boosts product development visibility with AI
items.summary_zh: 据 Chain Store Age 报道，Urban Outfitters Inc. 正利用AI提升产品开发环节的可见度/透明度。报道未披露其采用的具体技术方案、合作供应商或预期收益。此举显示零售企业正把AI引入产品开发流程，以改善协作与决策效率。
items.summary_en: Urban Outfitters Inc. boosts product development visibility with AI Chain Store Age
items.why_zh: 零售企业将AI嵌入产品开发，体现AI从营销端向核心运营环节渗透。
items.why_en: Retailers embedding AI in product development shows AI moving from marketing into core operations.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 将设选举“作战室”追踪干预行为
items.title_en: OpenAI launching election war room to track interference efforts
items.summary_zh: 据 Politico 报道，OpenAI 将设立选举“作战室”，用于追踪干预选举的相关行动。报道未在摘要中说明该机制的具体运作方式、覆盖选举范围及应对措施。此举表明，AI公司正加强对选举期间虚假信息、滥用和外部干预的监测。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launching election war room to track interference efforts Politico
items.why_zh: 生成式AI在大选中的滥用风险上升，平台方的监测机制关系到选举信息安全。
items.why_en: As the risk of generative AI misuse in elections grows, platform monitoring matters for election information integrity.

items.title_zh: 特朗普政府回滚健康AI监管
items.title_en: Trump admin rolls back health AI regulation
items.summary_zh: 据 Politico 报道，特朗普政府正在回滚/放宽针对健康AI的监管。报道未在摘要中披露具体政策条款、受影响范围及实施时间。此举可能改变医疗AI产品的合规路径，并在创新速度与患者安全之间引发新的讨论。
items.summary_en: Trump admin rolls back health AI regulation Politico
items.why_zh: 医疗AI监管松紧直接影响产品落地速度与安全审查标准。
items.why_en: The strength of health AI regulation directly affects how quickly products reach the market and how safety is reviewed.

items.title_zh: 智谱获南向资金连续4天净买入
items.title_en: Zhipu AI Sees Four Consecutive Days of Southbound Net Buying
items.summary_zh: 智谱获南向资金连续4天净买入 Moomoo

The report did not disclose specific amounts or holdings changes, but sustained southbound inflows are typically read as a sign of growing mainland investor interest.
items.why_zh: 连续南向净买入反映内地资金对这家国产大模型公司的关注度变化，是观察其市场表现的一个信号。
items.why_en: Sustained southbound inflows offer a signal of mainland investor interest in one of China's flagship LLM companies.

items.title_zh: 智谱获南向资金连续4天净买入

items.why_zh: 南向资金的持续流入，是衡量资本市场对国产大模型公司信心的一项即时指标。
items.why_en: Sustained southbound inflows are a real-time gauge of investor confidence in China's large-model companies.

items.title_zh: 智谱获南向资金连续4天净买入
items.title_en: Zhipu Sees Four Straight Days of Net Southbound Buying
items.summary_zh: 智谱获南向资金连续4天净买入 富途牛牛
items.summary_en: Zhipu has recorded four consecutive trading days of net buying by southbound capital, according to Futu. Persistent inflows are often read as a sign of rising investor attention to the stock.
items.why_zh: 资金持续流入，反映市场对国产大模型公司的关注度正在升温。
items.why_en: Sustained inflows signal warming investor interest in China's model developers.

items.title_zh: 字节跳动重构ToB版图：飞书与豆包将整合 大厂激战“AI工作入口”
items.title_en: ByteDance Restructures ToB Business: Feishu and Doubao to Be Integrated
items.summary_zh: 字节跳动重构ToB版图：飞书与豆包将整合 大厂激战“AI工作入口” 财联社
items.summary_en: ByteDance is restructuring its enterprise-facing business and plans to integrate its collaboration suite Feishu with the AI assistant Doubao, Cailian Press reports. The move is seen as a push into the "AI work entry point" battleground, where major Chinese tech firms are competing over workplace and productivity scenarios. Details of the integration were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 办公套件与 AI 助手合并，说明大厂争夺的已不是模型本身，而是用户每天进入 AI 的那道入口。
items.why_en: Merging a collaboration suite with an AI assistant shows the real battle is over the entry point users pass through daily, not the model itself.

items.title_zh: 摩根大通将牵头 Anthropic IPO 的散户认购销售
items.title_en: JPMorgan to lead retail share sales for Anthropic IPO
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance 报道，摩根大通将牵头负责 Anthropic 首次公开募股（IPO）中的散户投资者认购份额销售工作。这意味着 Anthropic 的上市安排正在推进，并已确定由大型投行承担面向个人投资者的分销环节。报道未提及发行规模、估值或时间表等具体细节。由摩根大通牵头散户配售，通常有助于扩大发行覆盖面与认购需求。
items.summary_en: JPMorgan to lead retail share sales for Anthropic IPO Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: Anthropic 是头部大模型公司，其 IPO 承销安排是 AI 行业资本化进程的重要风向标。
items.why_en: Anthropic is a leading AI model developer, making its IPO underwriting arrangements a key signal for the sector's capital markets push.

items.title_zh: 有人开源复刻 Harvey 的法律 AI：对方融资 5 亿美元
items.title_en: Harvey raised 500M for legal AI, I built the same and open sourced it
items.summary_zh: 在 Hacker News 上，有开发者发布项目 CaseCite，称法律 AI 公司 Harvey 融资 5 亿美元，而自己以开源方式实现了同类工具。帖子附带了 GitHub 仓库地址与讨论链接，目前获得 68 分、32 条评论。讨论集中在法律 AI 的技术门槛是否被高估，以及开源方案能否在真实法律工作流中替代商业产品。帖子本身未提供功能对比或性能评测数据。
items.summary_en: Article URL: https://github.com/thomasunise/casecite Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50273623 Points: 68 # Comments: 32
items.why_zh: 法律 AI 是当前融资最热的垂直赛道之一，开源复刻的出现让“高融资是否等于高技术壁垒”成为可讨论的问题。
items.why_en: Legal AI is one of the hottest funded verticals, and an open-source challenger raises questions about how much of that funding reflects real technical moats.

items.title_zh: 豆包：相关传言严重失实
items.title_en: Doubao Says Related Rumors Are 'Seriously Inaccurate'
items.summary_zh: 豆包：相关传言严重失实 搜狐网
items.summary_en: ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao denied circulating rumors as "seriously inaccurate," according to Sohu. The report did not specify the content of the rumors or any further response from the company.
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 产品对传言的公开否认，直接影响公众与市场对其业务状态的判断。
items.why_en: A public denial from a major AI assistant maker shapes how the public and market read its business status.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek API 价格 · OrcaRouter — 11 个模型，0 加价
items.title_en: OrcaRouter Lists DeepSeek API Access: 11 Models, Zero Markup
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek API 价格 · OrcaRouter — 11 个模型，0 加价 OrcaRouter
items.summary_en: OrcaRouter published a DeepSeek API pricing page advertising access to 11 models with zero markup on top of base pricing. The listing targets developers routing across models, though per-model rates, rate limits and terms were not detailed.
items.why_zh: 推理成本是开发者选型的核心变量，聚合层的定价策略直接影响 DeepSeek 模型的实际使用门槛。
items.why_en: Inference cost is a core selection factor for developers, and router-layer pricing directly affects how accessible DeepSeek models are.

items.title_zh: 医生“查豆包”开药，背后的问题值得思考
items.title_en: Doctors Checking Doubao Before Prescribing Raises Wider Questions
items.summary_zh: 医生“查豆包”开药，背后的问题值得思考 极目新闻
items.summary_en: A Jimu News commentary examines reports of doctors consulting the AI assistant Doubao before prescribing, arguing the practice raises questions about accuracy and accountability when general-purpose AI enters clinical workflows. No specific case details or regulatory conclusions were given.
items.why_zh: 通用大模型进入临床辅助环节，把 AI 输出可靠性与医疗责任归属这两个问题推到了台前。
items.why_en: General-purpose AI entering clinical support work raises hard questions about output reliability and medical accountability.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 文件警告部分风险“不可承保”，AI 保险将成所有企业议题
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO filing warns some risks may be uninsurable. AI coverage will be issue for every company
items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，Anthropic 的 IPO 文件警告称，公司面临的某些风险可能无法通过保险覆盖。报道指出，随着 AI 应用扩散，AI 相关风险的承保问题将成为每家企业都要面对的议题。这给快速扩张的 AI 行业提出了一个现实问题：当风险无法定价或被保险排除在外时，后果由谁来承担。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO filing warns some risks may be uninsurable. AI coverage will be issue for every company CNBC
items.why_zh: 保险缺位意味着 AI 风险的成本最终可能由企业和社会自行消化。
items.why_en: If insurance can't cover AI risk, the cost ultimately falls on companies and society.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 递交 IPO 文件，进一步强化 AI 股逻辑
items.title_en: Anthropic’s IPO Filing Just Strengthened the Case for AI Stocks
items.summary_zh: InvestorPlace 刊文称，Anthropic 的 IPO 申报文件为 AI 板块的投资逻辑提供了更有力的支撑。文章认为，头部模型公司走向公开市场，为投资者提供了观察该行业收入与成本结构的窗口，从而影响对整个 AI 股票群体的判断。报道未详细列出申报文件中的具体财务数字。整体论调偏向认为这一进展对 AI 概念股构成正面信号。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s IPO Filing Just Strengthened the Case for AI Stocks InvestorPlace
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司上市申报，为整个板块提供了少有的可比财务参照。
items.why_en: A leading AI company's filing gives the sector a rare comparable financial reference point.

items.title_zh: “大空头”Michael Burry：Anthropic 招股书显示 AI 行业“极其脆弱”
items.title_en: 'Big Short' investor Michael Burry says Anthropic's IPO filing shows the AI industry is 'catastrophically vulnerable'
items.summary_zh: 据 Business Insider 报道，以“大空头”闻名的投资人 Michael Burry 表示，Anthropic 的 IPO 申报文件显示 AI 行业处于“极其脆弱”（catastrophically vulnerable）的状态。Burry 长期对 AI 热潮持怀疑态度，此次他援引招股文件中的信息作为论据。报道未详细展开他具体引用了哪些数据或指标。这一表态与市场上看多 AI 的声音形成鲜明对比。
items.summary_en: 'Big Short' investor Michael Burry says Anthropic's IPO filing shows the AI industry is 'catastrophically vulnerable' Business Insider
items.why_zh: 知名空头公开质疑 AI 行业财务稳健性，与当前看多情绪形成对立，放大市场分歧。
items.why_en: A prominent short seller publicly questioning AI's financial resilience sharpens the divide in market sentiment.

items.title_zh: 为何 Anthropic 的 IPO 是高风险生意
items.title_en: Why Anthropic's IPO is risky business
items.summary_zh: CNBC 围绕 Anthropic 的 IPO 讨论其为何是一笔高风险生意。作为领先的 AI 模型公司，Anthropic 上市后将面对公开市场对 AI 业务的审视与定价。报道提示，投资者需要在 AI 热潮与不确定性之间做出权衡。
items.summary_en: Why Anthropic's IPO is risky business CNBC
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司上市将检验公开市场对高估值 AI 业务的真实承受力。
items.why_en: A leading AI company’s IPO would test public investors’ appetite for high-valuation AI businesses.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉OTA内置豆包和DeepSeek大模型
items.title_en: Tesla OTA Update Adds Doubao and DeepSeek Models
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉OTA内置豆包和DeepSeek大模型 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Tesla’s OTA update reportedly integrates Doubao and DeepSeek models into its vehicle system. The move points to Chinese large models being used for in-car features. Specific functions and rollout details were not provided.
items.why_zh: 车企在量产车中集成国产大模型，显示 AI 助手正成为智能座舱竞争焦点。
items.why_en: Integrating Chinese LLMs into production cars shows AI assistants are becoming a key smart-cockpit battleground.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO：窥见 AI 未来的一扇窗
items.title_en: The Anthropic IPO: A Window Into the Future of AI
items.summary_zh: ETF Database 刊文将 Anthropic 的 IPO 视为观察 AI 行业未来的窗口。文章借这次上市讨论 AI 公司如何进入资本市场，以及投资者如何参与这一前沿领域。Anthropic 的上市进程可能为评估 AI 商业模式与估值提供重要参照。
items.summary_en: The Anthropic IPO: A Window Into the Future of AI ETF Database
items.why_zh: 这次 IPO 不只是融资事件，也可能成为 AI 资产进入主流投资组合的样本。
items.why_en: The IPO is not just fundraising; it could become a template for bringing AI assets into mainstream portfolios.

items.title_zh: 特朗普拟禁用“人工智能”一词，欲改用其他说法
items.title_en: Pres. Trump plans to ban the term 'artificial intelligence.' Here's what he wants to use instead
items.summary_zh: 报道称，美国总统特朗普计划禁用“人工智能”这一术语，并希望改用另一种表述。该消息未在摘要中说明替代词是什么，也未交代具体政策形式。若付诸实施，可能影响政府文件与公共传播中的用词。
items.summary_en: Pres. Trump plans to ban the term 'artificial intelligence.' Here's what he wants to use instead WSMV
items.why_zh: 官方术语的变化可能重塑 AI 政策的叙事框架与公众认知。
items.why_en: Changing official terminology could reshape the narrative and public perception of AI policy.

items.title_zh: AI 宪法需要行政法律师
items.title_en: AI Constitutions Need Administrative Lawyers
items.summary_zh: 耶鲁监管期刊的文章主张，AI 治理规则或“AI 宪法”的制定需要行政法律师参与。文章强调，AI 系统的规则设计不只是技术问题，还涉及程序、问责与监管执行。引入行政法专业经验，有助于让 AI 治理更具可操作性和合法性。
items.summary_en: AI Constitutions Need Administrative Lawyers Yale Journal on Regulation
items.why_zh: AI 治理正从原则宣言走向制度执行，行政法专业能力将变得关键。
items.why_en: As AI governance moves from principles to implementation, administrative-law expertise becomes critical.

items.title_zh: 不止创始人：Anthropic IPO 让本地人致富
items.title_en: Beyond the founders: The locals getting rich off Anthropic’s IPO
items.summary_zh: 《旧金山标准报》报道，Anthropic 的 IPO 不仅让创始人受益，也让部分本地人获得财富。文章聚焦“创始人之外”的群体，探讨上市如何把财富效应扩散到更广泛的人群。具体受益者构成与金额未在摘要中披露。
items.summary_en: Beyond the founders: The locals getting rich off Anthropic’s IPO The San Francisco Standard
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司的上市财富效应可能改变本地经济与社会结构。
items.why_en: Wealth effects from a leading AI IPO could reshape local economies and communities.

items.title_zh: 患者家属吐槽医生用AI开药，医院称只是辅助查询，你能接受医生用AI查用药吗？
items.title_en: Family Complains Doctor Used AI to Prescribe; Hospital Says It Was Auxiliary
items.summary_zh: 患者家属吐槽医生用AI开药，医院称只是辅助查询，你能接受医生用AI查用药吗？ 观察者网
items.summary_en: A patient’s family complained that a doctor used AI to prescribe medication, sparking debate over AI in clinical settings. The hospital said the tool was only for auxiliary queries, not direct prescribing. The case raises questions about safety, responsibility and public trust.
items.why_zh: 医疗 AI 从辅助工具走向临床决策边缘，责任边界与公众信任成为焦点。
items.why_en: As medical AI edges into clinical decisions, liability boundaries and public trust become central.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 申请 IPO：估值或达 2 万亿美元，拟募资超 1000 亿美元
items.title_en: Anthropic files for IPO that could value it at $2T, raise over $100B
items.summary_zh: 报道称，Anthropic 已提交 IPO 申请，估值可能达到 2 万亿美元，并计划募资超过 1000 亿美元。若按这一规模完成，将成为 AI 行业乃至资本市场的高度瞩目事件。摘要未披露上市时间、承销团队等更多细节。
items.summary_en: Anthropic files for IPO that could value it at $2T, raise over $100B Dealroom
items.why_zh: 若估值与募资规模属实，将刷新 AI 公司上市纪录并重塑行业资本格局。
items.why_en: If the reported scale holds, it would set a benchmark for AI listings and reshape industry capital flows.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 收购一人制生物科技公司 Mithril，启动药物研发项目
items.title_en: Anthropic acquires one-person biotech Mithril, starts drug programs
items.summary_zh: 据 Quartz 报道，AI 公司 Anthropic 收购了一家名为 Mithril 的生物科技公司，这家公司仅有一名员工，规模极小。收购完成后，Anthropic 借此正式启动自身的药物研发项目，把 AI 能力延伸到生物医药领域。报道未披露交易金额与具体研发方向等细节，但这一动作表明，头部大模型公司正尝试直接进入药物发现与开发环节，而不只是提供通用模型工具。
items.summary_en: Anthropic acquires one-person biotech Mithril, starts drug programs Quartz
items.why_zh: 这标志着头部大模型公司开始直接下场做药物研发，AI 与生物医药的融合从“工具输出”走向“亲自立项”。
items.why_en: It marks a leading AI lab moving beyond selling model access into running its own drug programs, deepening the AI-biotech convergence.

items.title_zh: 上市前夜：Anthropic 与特朗普政府的紧张关系浮出水面
items.title_en: Anthropic’s Tensions With Trump Laid Bare Ahead of Landmark IPO
items.summary_zh: 据 Bloomberg 报道，在备受关注的 IPO 之前，AI 公司 Anthropic 与美国特朗普政府之间的紧张关系被公开暴露出来。报道以“里程碑式 IPO”为背景，聚焦双方在政策与监管层面的摩擦。原文未进一步披露具体的冲突细节与上市时间、估值等信息，但可以看出，头部 AI 公司在走向资本市场的同时，正越来越多地卷入政治与监管博弈。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Tensions With Trump Laid Bare Ahead of Landmark IPO Bloomberg.com
items.why_zh: 对即将上市的 AI 巨头而言，与执政者的关系正成为与技术和资本同等重要的风险变量。
items.why_en: For an AI company heading to public markets, political relations are becoming as material a risk factor as technology and capital.

items.title_zh: 特朗普称计划正式禁用“AI”“artificial intelligence”等说法
items.title_en: Trump says he plans to officially ban terms 'AI' and 'artificial intelligence'
items.summary_zh: 据 WHAS11 报道，美国总统特朗普表示，他计划正式禁止使用“AI”和“artificial intelligence”这两个说法。报道仅给出这一表态本身，未说明禁令将以何种形式落地、适用范围如何，也未交代替代用语或生效时间。若真的推行，这一表态可能影响美国政府在文件、机构名称与公开表述中的用词习惯。
items.summary_en: Trump says he plans to officially ban terms 'AI' and 'artificial intelligence' WHAS11
items.why_zh: 美国政府最高层对基础技术术语的表态，可能牵动官方文件、机构命名与政策沟通的用词规则。
items.why_en: A presidential move against a basic technology term could reshape how government documents, agencies and policy communications are worded.

items.title_en: Doctors Are Opening Doubao in Front of Patients — and Most Peers Already Do
items.summary_zh: 医生当着患者面打开豆包，是不靠谱还是真香？超八成同行早已在用 新浪财经
items.summary_en: A Sina Finance report examines doctors using ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao in front of patients, framing the debate as "unreliable or surprisingly useful." It notes that more than 80% of peers already use such AI tools, raising questions about efficiency gains versus patient trust and medical responsibility.
items.why_zh: AI 助手正从医生私下使用走向诊室现场，医疗场景的信任与责任边界需要重新界定。
items.why_en: AI assistants are moving from私下 use to the examining room, forcing a rethink of trust and accountability in clinical settings.

items.title_en: Doctors Open Doubao in Front of Patients as Over 80% of Peers Use AI
items.summary_zh: 医生当着患者面打开豆包，是不靠谱还是真香？超八成同行早已在用 搜狐网
items.summary_en: A Sohu report says a growing number of doctors are opening ByteDance's Doubao AI assistant in front of patients during consultations, and that more than 80% of their peers already use such tools. The debate centers on real-world usage, how patients react, and whether the answers are reliable enough for clinical settings.
items.why_zh: AI 进入门诊现场，把模型准确性和医疗责任归属问题从讨论区直接搬到了诊室。
items.why_en: AI showing up in the exam room moves questions of accuracy and medical accountability from forums into clinical practice.

items.title_zh: DSH测试文件“泄密”，DeepSeek V5就要来了？
items.title_en: Leaked Test Files Spark Speculation About DeepSeek V5
items.summary_zh: DSH测试文件“泄密”，DeepSeek V5就要来了？ 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Sohu reports that a leaked test file labeled DSH has triggered speculation that DeepSeek's next model, V5, may be imminent. Details such as timing, scale or capability gains remain unconfirmed, but the chatter reflects intense market interest in the pace of Chinese model releases.
items.why_zh: 一次测试文件曝光就能搅动市场预期，说明 DeepSeek 的每次版本迭代都被视为行业风向标。
items.why_en: A single leaked test file is enough to move expectations, showing that each DeepSeek release is treated as an industry bellwether.
